title: Introducing Bujeti Treasury and Savings | Bujeti
summary: All-in-one financial management for African businesses. Track expenses, automate payments, issue corporate cards, and streamline your finances with Bujeti.
body_markdown:
Most growing businesses have cash in the wrong place. Some of it sits in a current account for weeks between payment runs, earning nothing. The rest gets moved by hand every time payroll, tax or a big supplier payment comes due. Someone on the finance team checks the balance, makes the transfer and hopes nothing was missed.


Today we're launching two products that fix both problems. Savings puts your idle business cash to work so it earns every day. Treasury moves money between your accounts automatically, based on rules you set. Together, they make Bujeti the business account that puts idle cash to work.


##### What is treasury management?


Treasury management is how a business manages its cash, liquidity, financial risk and banking relationships so it can stay stable and grow.


It matters more than most teams realise. A business can be growing fast, with strong revenue, and still struggle to pay vendors on time because cash is tied up in receivables or sitting in the wrong account. Without a live view of balances, forecasting turns into guesswork, and the finance team spends its week moving money instead of managing it.


Good treasury management comes down to three things:


-


**The right amount of cash:** Enough on hand to cover what's due, without large sums sitting idle.


-


**In the right place:** Money for tax, payroll and suppliers set aside before anyone can spend it.


-


**At the right time:** Accounts funded before payments go out, not after a payment fails.


Large corporates have treasury teams and bank relationship managers to do this. Most growing businesses have a spreadsheet and a busy finance manager. Bujeti Treasury and Savings give every business the same discipline, automatically.


##### Bujeti Savings: earns like savings, works like a current account


Bujeti Savings gives your business interest-earning naira pots inside Bujeti. You move spare cash in, and it earns 3% a year, accrued daily and credited to your pot every month.


What makes Savings different is access. There's no lock-in and no lock-up. You can withdraw from Savings or pay directly from it at any time, with no limits and no penalties, and interest you've already earned stays yours. Most savings products ask you to give up access to your money in exchange for a return. Savings doesn't.


You can open as many pots as you need: one for your tax reserve, one for an emergency buffer, one for a planned purchase. Each pot earns on its own balance, and every pot shows what it earned each day. Interest arrives on its own statement line, separate from deposits and withdrawals, so your accountant can book it in one step.


##### Bujeti Treasury: a treasurer who works on your rules


Bujeti Treasury does the work your finance team does by hand today. You set the rules once, and Treasury moves the money.


Think of it as a treasurer who never misses a deadline. It watches your accounts, moves money when your conditions are met and keeps a record of every move. Here's what it can do.


-


###### Keep an operating minimum


Every account needs a working balance to cover its day-to-day payments. Set that level once, and Treasury holds each account there.


When the balance rises above your operating minimum, the surplus moves into Savings, where it earns. When a large payment takes the balance below the minimum, money moves back to top it up. Your accounts stay funded, your spare cash stays productive, and nobody has to pull money back at the last minute.


-


###### Set aside tax as you earn


Tax money is the easiest money to spend by accident, because it sits in the same account as everything else until filing time.


A tax reserve rule moves a share of every payment you receive into a separate account or Savings pot the moment it lands. You choose the percentage, using the rate your accountant advises. When it's time to file, the money is already there. Bujeti also keeps a record of every payment that funded the reserve, so you can always see exactly why it holds what it holds. If your reserve sits in a Savings pot, it earns until the day you pay.


-


###### Fund payroll before payday


Payroll week shouldn't depend on someone remembering to move money.


A payroll prefund rule moves your payroll total into your payroll account a set number of days before pay date. If you run payroll on Bujeti, the amount matches your payroll run. If there isn't enough money to cover it, Bujeti tells you early, while there's still time to act.


-


###### Split money as it arrives


Some businesses need every payment divided the moment it comes in: platform fees and partner payouts, a landlord's share and property costs, or simply profit, tax and operations.


Split on arrival sends set percentages or fixed amounts of each payment you receive to up to eight accounts or recipients. It works on deposits, invoices and payment links, so the money is in the right place before anyone can spend it. You can also run a scheduled split on a set day each week or month instead.


-


###### Pay in the order you choose


When cash arrives in lumps, someone usually decides who gets paid first. Payment priority makes that decision once.


Set the order (for example, rent, then salaries, then key suppliers) and Treasury pays each obligation in turn as money comes in. If there isn't enough for everything, the most important payments are covered first.


-


###### Protect a minimum balance


Some money should never move automatically, whatever your rules say.


A minimum balance hold keeps a set amount in an account that no rule can touch. It's your safety net: automation works around it, and only a person on your team can move it.


-


###### Start from rules built for your industry


You don't have to design your rules from scratch. Treasury includes starter rule sets for 13 business types, from schools and construction firms to agribusinesses and professional services. Pick the one closest to your business, adjust the numbers, and you're ready to go.


##### How Treasury and Savings work together


Say your main account holds ₦40 million and you only need ₦15 million on hand for the month. Set an operating minimum of ₦15 million, and Treasury moves the other ₦25 million into Savings. At 3% a year, that's about ₦2,050 a day, or roughly ₦750,000 over a year, on money that would otherwise earn nothing.


If a large payment brings your main account below ₦15 million, Treasury tops it back up. Your cash earns while it waits and comes back when you need it, without anyone on your team touching it.


##### You stay in control


Automation only works if you can trust it, so nothing moves until you say so.


-


**Every rule starts as a draft:** Drafts never move money.


-


**Preview before you commit:** Before a rule goes live, Bujeti shows you what it would have done over the last 90 days.


-


**You confirm it yourself:** A rule only runs once someone on your team turns it on.


-


**Pause any time:** Pausing a rule takes effect immediately.


-


**A full record:** Every move shows in the rule history, with the reason it happened.


-


**No clashes:** If two rules would move the same money in opposite directions, Bujeti won't let both go live.


-


**Approvals still apply:** Require two approvers for large transfers, just as you do today.


Treasury only moves money you already hold, between accounts and recipients you name. It never borrows and never overdraws.


##### Built for how your business runs


Treasury and Savings sit inside the same platform you already use for payments, payroll, invoices and approvals, so your rules attach to the money as it moves through Bujeti.


-


**Schools:** Fees collected once a term earn until they're spent, while payroll is funded every month.


-


**Construction firms:** Project money earns between draws, and subcontractors are paid in order.


-


**Professional services firms:** Retainers earn until the work is billed.


-


**Agribusinesses:** Harvest income earns through the season and stays available for inputs, with tax set aside as it comes in.


##### Get started in two minutes


1.


Open **Savings** in your Bujeti dashboard and create your first pot.


2.


Move in the cash you won't need this month. It starts earning straight away.


3.


Open **Treasury** and set an operating minimum on your main account, or pick a starter rule built for your industry.


Prefer a walkthrough? Book a 15-minute call with our[team](https://booking.bujeti.com/team/sales/website-demo) , and we'll set up your first rules with you.


##### What's next


Treasury and Savings run on naira accounts today. Support for other currencies is coming in a later release, and so is the overnight sweep, which will move spare cash into Savings at the end of each day and bring it back before morning.


More than 2,000 businesses already run their finances on Bujeti. From today, their idle cash can work as hard as their teams do.
